required_unknowns: No current finite survey can establish that life or technology is absent from the universe.
Exoplanet biosignature likelihoods remain context, retrieval, and model dependent.
Technosignature candidates require artifact and interference adjudication.
In-situ evidence requires provenance and contamination controls.
required_human_review_items: Verify source metadata against publisher pages when browser access is available.
Approve data, observatory, mission, planetary-protection, and laboratory constraints before any execution.
Review all public statements about candidate biological or technological activity.
writing_constraints: Write in English and IEEE conference style.
Do not include acknowledgement, funding, or personal-note sections.
Do not state or imply a life or technosignature detection from the proposed work.
State evidence-backed conclusions directly within their source scope and reserve conditional wording for unresolved alternatives.
Distinguish habitability, candidate evidence, confirmation, and sensitivity-limited null results.
